hero.subheadline: Powered by cyclical intelligence for smarter, more empathetic coaching.
hero.card: JOMOA helps coaches build structured macro/meso/micro programs, follow progress over time, and add cycle-informed insights when relevant.

cardA.title: Traditional tools assume linear bodies.
cardA.body: Female physiology varies across the cycle. Most platforms ignore that—making sustainable coaching harder.

cardB.title: JOMOA brings cyclical intelligence into coaching.
cardB.body: Data + physiology + behavior insights so you can adapt training with confidence—not guesswork.

items: Build programs in macro / meso / micro cycles
Track sessions with sets / reps / RPE + notes
Optional cycle insights module for clients

steps: Track training and recovery over time
howItWorks.tagline: JOMOA isn't about training women "differently"—it's about coaching smarter.
